textNodes.text: We cut the work into releases you can actually use. A working slice every two weeks beats a perfect plan that ships in six months.

textNodes.text: Product design and front-end for startups and brands in Europe and the US.
Led design of the mobile app from beta to 1.2M users.
Built the design system in Figma and React.
Brand and web projects for cultural clients.

textNodes.text: Cut out and kept. A few words from the people I’ve designed and shipped with.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Mara designed it and then built half of it. We shipped two months early.
The brand looked like us from the first round. Customers ask who made our bags.
The rare designer who reads a pull request. Our docs finally feel fast.
She gave us one system our designers and engineers both trust.
Fast, calm and very, very good with detail.
